providers.name: Wikimedia Commons
providers.usage: Public API; licences vary per file (shown with each result).

providers.name: Internet Archive
providers.usage: Public search API; rights vary per item — check each item before use.
uses: Stock search (video, images) with item rights links

providers.name: CapCut
providers.usage: No public API. Download the MP4 from My Videos and import it into CapCut.

providers.name: Canva
providers.usage: Canva Connect API access requires a registered Canva integration.
providers.approval: Register a Canva Connect integration (and pass Canva review for public use) before StoryFlow can connect.
uses: Planned: send thumbnails and assets to Canva designs

providers.name: Mixkit
providers.usage: No API. Download assets from Mixkit and keep the source link for licence records.
uses: Manual asset import with source links

providers.name: YouTube
providers.usage: YouTube Data API quota (units per day per Google Cloud project).
providers.approval: Uploads from unverified API projects are locked to private until the project passes a YouTube API audit; the upload scope needs Google OAuth verification.

providers.name: TikTok
providers.usage: Content Posting API rate limits per user.
providers.approval: Requires a TikTok developer app with the Content Posting API approved; unaudited apps can only post privately.
uses: Planned: send videos to TikTok drafts

providers.name: Pinterest
providers.usage: Pinterest API v5 rate limits; trial access until approved.
providers.approval: Requires a Pinterest developer app with approved (standard) API access.

providers.name: Google Drive
providers.usage: Uses your Google account storage quota.
uses: Copy finished videos to your Drive

providers.name: Supabase Storage
providers.usage: Private workspace bucket; storage counts toward your Supabase plan.
